offering_description.value: Develops and sells inhaled insulin for people with diabetes and a wearable infusion system that delivers a diuretic to patients with fluid overload. It also develops and manufactures dry-powder inhaled medicines for pharmaceutical partners, including a treatment for pulmonary hypertension.

primary_products.value: inhaled treprostinil; rapid-acting inhaled insulin; subcutaneous furosemide with a wearable infusion device

primary_services.value: inhaled drug formulation and development; contract manufacturing of inhaled medicines

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical partners, drug wholesalers, and specialty pharmacies

end_markets.value: pulmonary hypertension treatment; diabetes care; fluid overload management in heart failure and kidney disease

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: royalties on partner sales of inhaled treprostinil; product sales: inhaled insulin and wearable furosemide infusion systems; project or contract: drug formulation, development, manufacturing, and supply under pharmaceutical partnership agreements
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: formulates active ingredients into inhaled dry-powder medicines for wholesalers and pharmaceutical partners; service provider: develops inhaled formulations and manufactures finished medicines for pharmaceutical partners; brand owner: markets a wearable furosemide infusion system made by contract suppliers for specialty pharmacies
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; brand owner

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States, with inhaled insulin reaching Brazil and India through local partners

specialization.value: related lines: inhaled medicines, wearable drug delivery, and pharmaceutical development and manufacturing partnerships

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty distributors; third-party retail: retail and specialty pharmacies dispensing prescriptions; direct sales: direct supply to pharmaceutical partners under manufacturing agreements; partners / resellers: partner-led sales of inhaled treprostinil and local commercialization of inhaled insulin abroad
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval and manufacturing quality requirements for prescription drugs and drug-device combination products

notes: The current commercial status of the legacy wearable insulin patch is uncertain.
